Outschool is an online learning platform focused on inspiring children through flexible and engaging educational experiences. The company is seeking full-stack Software Engineers to develop and improve products for parents, learners, and educators using an agentic-first development paradigm, with responsibilities spanning product innovation, AI-native development, technical collaboration, and production operations.

Responsibilities
Drive complex, high-impact engineering initiatives across a variety of product innovation areas
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to align on roadmap priorities, technical tradeoffs, risks, and execution strategy
Demonstrate AI-native development mindset leveraging fully agentic development workflows, while also contributing to establishing principles and best practices on AI development
For senior roles, mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams through strong collaboration, communication, and domain expertise
Participate in standups, sprint planning, retros, production deployments, and on-call rotations
